item.name: Datadog Get Historical Cost Across Your Account

request.name: Datadog Get Historical Cost Across Your Account

description.content:
Get historical cost across multi-org and single root-org accounts.
Cost data for a given month becomes available no later than the 16th of the following month.

This endpoint is only accessible for [parent-level organizations](https://docs.datadoghq.com/account_management/multi_organization/).

query.description: String to specify whether cost is broken down at a parent-org level or at the sub-org level. Available views are `summary` and `sub-org`.  Defaults to `summary`.
(Required) Datetime in ISO-8601 format, UTC, precise to month: `[YYYY-MM]` for cost beginning this month.
Datetime in ISO-8601 format, UTC, precise to month: `[YYYY-MM]` for cost ending this month.
Boolean to specify whether to include accounts connected to the current account as partner customers in the Datadog partner network program. Defaults to `false`.
